finding: 16 legal singleton REPLACE is not a certificate of four mutually compatible joint replacements.

proposed_metrics.name: M_resource(t,K)
proposed_metrics.meaning: Maximum resource-independent subset of uncapped physically legal singleton inventory, with old/new footprint and parallel-pair conflicts; exact conflict-graph independent-set solver, not matching.

proposed_metrics.name: M_joint(t,K)
proposed_metrics.meaning: Maximum cardinality among resource-independent batches additionally passing whole Gate B/C/time-line safety; report exact/certified-bound status. Pairwise compatibility alone is insufficient.

proposed_metrics.name: exists_safe_size_2_3_4
proposed_metrics.meaning: Separate certified booleans with witnesses or exact infeasibility. Exhaustion of bounded search => UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

proposed_metrics.name: mode_composition
proposed_metrics.meaning: For each feasible size: all BBM/all MBB/mixed composition witnesses/counts if exact; whole transition safety and completion bounds.

proposed_metrics.name: conflict_reasons
proposed_metrics.meaning: Repeated old, old/new terminal footprint, existing reservation/owner, parallel pair, physical-window and joint connectivity conflict.

proposed_metrics.name: operational_cap_loss
proposed_metrics.meaning: Compare full structural witnesses with proposed capped runtime pool coverage; no traffic or economic score.

possible_new_hard_gate.proposal: exists_safe_size4 over a human-preregistered minimum fraction of20 samples
possible_new_hard_gate.recommendation: First record diagnostics; m<=4 permission does not require m=4 always. Do not automatically change K-selection.
possible_new_hard_gate.bias: Could push K upward, penalize terminal/lifetime bottlenecks, prefer spare-terminal MBB structures and exclude useful networks controllable with m1-3. Initial static snapshots also do not prove runtime reservation availability.

solver_boundary: No maximum matching, independent-set solving, Z_K building, uncapped replacement enumeration or structural mode scan executed in this design gate.
implementation_dependency: Define/approve batch physical/safety predicate before K0-v1.2 audit; implement validator correctness before selecting K*. Use same predicate in K0 and F3-v2, not economic controller evaluator.
